gameName: Ticket to Ride Legacy: Legends of the West

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Ticket to Ride Legacy: Legends of the West rulebook (Days of Wonder, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Assemble the board from its current pieces (5 at the start of the campaign)
Each player empties their company box's office (not the vault)
Each player takes {n} dollars in coins
Shuffle {n} newspapers into the train deck; the rest go to the store room
Deal 4 train cards each; turn 5 faceup next to the deck
steps.note: Reshuffle and replace any newspaper dealt or shown; redraw all 5 if 3 are locomotives

steps.text: Deal 4 tickets each; keep at least 2, return the rest to the bottom of the ticket deck
Read the story deck (both sides of each card) until it tells you to stop
The player with the caboose card goes first; play is clockwise
